summary: Payee bank branch code mismatch causing recurring vendor payment to fail
description:
Issue summary: A recurring monthly payment to vendor 'Greenline Supplies' (vendor ID VND-4487) failed during today's scheduled run. The payment was rejected by the bank with code BK-142 (branch code mismatch). Impact: Scheduled payout did not complete, leaving a vendor invoice in 'Pending Payment' and generating a failed-remittance alert to finance. This affects one recurring vendor (monthly subscription) and may block vendor services if not remediated.

Context: The recurring payment profile was created in the AP system on 2024-11-09 and has run successfully for 4 cycles. Today's run (2026-03-10 02:30 UTC) returned a bank-level rejection. Vendor has supplied updated bank details but the branch code in our AP record appears to differ from the bank-returned expected value.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Navigate to AP -> Scheduled Payments -> March 2026 run
2) Locate vendor VND-4487 'Greenline Supplies' recurring entry
3) Trigger a manual 'payment retry' for the failed transaction TX-20260310-GRN1
4) Observe gateway response, and bank rejection code returned
5) Verify bank account and branch code stored in AP record against vendor-provided remittance PDF
logs: Gateway response: HTTP 402 Payment Required, body={"status":"rejected","reason_code":"BK-142","reason":"branch code mismatch","expected_branch":"0314","provided_branch":"0341"}
AP system record VND-4487: bank_account_last4=5829, branch_code=0341, created_by=finance:louise.k, created_at=2024-11-09
Vendor-supplied remittance (email id msg-20260308-GL): shows branch 0314 and IBAN ending ...5829
Payment gateway trace id: gt-9a4f3c2b, bank_ref: BR-2026-03-10-0915
comments: 2026-03-10 09:05 UTC - Louise K (Finance): Notified vendor yesterday about our scheduled debit; vendor replied with updated remittance showing branch 0314. I did not change AP record pending verification.
2026-03-10 10:12 UTC - Support Triage (Marco Ruiz): Assigned to payments team to validate branch mismatch and whether system override is safe for recurring runs.

2026-03-11 14:20 UTC - Payments Eng (Sunita Rao): Reproduced failure in staging by changing stored branch_code; gateway rejects when provided branch != bank's expected. Investigating source of branch_code difference (manual entry vs. import script).

2026-03-12 08:30 UTC - Finance (Aisha Patel): Confirmed vendor email signature and bank letter match branch 0314. Requesting safe remediation and whether to re-run missed payment immediately or schedule next cycle.
investigation_notes: Hypothesis 1: Manual data-entry error when vendor was onboarded 2024-11-09; AP record shows 0341 while vendor-provided documents indicate 0314.
Hypothesis 2: Legacy CSV import in 2025 may have transformed branch codes due to locale formatting (leading zeros stripped) - but here values differ not just leading zeros.
Payments team validated gateway behavior: branch_code is validated by bank ACH connector and mismatch returns BK-142 consistently.

Cross-checked vendor bank details with remittance PDF and vendor banking letter (received 2026-03-08): both state branch 0314 and IBAN ends with 5829, which matches our account last4, so account number is correct but our branch is wrong.

Reviewed audit trail on AP record: last modified 2025-06-15 by importer job 'ap-data-migration-v2' which shows source csv 'vendor_master_202506.csv' for this vendor. File excerpt attached to Confluence page.

Risk assessment: Changing branch in AP system for recurring payments is high-touch; if branch code has changed at the bank level for vendor, immediate retry could succeed. If we change wrongly, duplicate payment risk exists.

Decision: Hold on automatic retry until finance confirms vendor's bank letter. Prepare manual one-off payment path after confirmation. Implement data correction and add verification flag to recurring profiles.
resolution: Temporary workaround: Finance (Louise) obtained signed bank confirmation from Greenline Supplies and authorized a manual outgoing ACH using the bank portal on 2026-03-12 11:00 UTC; transaction reference BR-2026-03-12-001 succeeded. Root cause: vendor record in AP was overwritten during a legacy import (ap-data-migration-v2) on 2025-06-15 with incorrect branch 0341. Permanent fix actions: (1) Update AP vendor record VND-4487 to branch 0314 and add 'bank_verified: true' tag; (2) Add a small validation rule to importer to flag branch_code mismatches against vendor-provided IBAN checksum; (3) Add a QA run for legacy imports and correct other affected vendors (task INT-23112 created). Follow-up: Finance and Payments to schedule a 7-day audit of vendors imported by ap-data-migration-v2.
